findings.title: Budget rejection suppresses zero-inventory artifact publication

spec.quote: 失败不能阻止已有Lease Release/zero。

findings.trigger: Valid lowered budget with cleanup.zero=true, then rehearsal committed>=S or formal aggregate>H. The transition/complete step exits1 without continue-on-error.
findings.effect: Exact Release may already have completed, but default success() causes zero-inventory proof upload to be skipped.
findings.recommendation: Use explicit status guard: always() && steps.cleanup.outputs.zero == 'true', or persist cleanup proof before surfacing the qualification failure. Keep budget rejection in place.
findings.test_gap: Actual consumer shell tests verify threshold exit and local cleanup files; the static test mandates the bare if string. Neither accounts for Actions implicit success().
